summary: Iteration 40 - Verified compound subscription feature end-to-end: (1) P0 BUG FIX validated - Royal City admin (compound_id=88ad3711-c9ae-45fe-a270-65f4524c071c, subscription_type=lifetime) logs in and trial banner is HIDDEN on /app/dashboard (0 occurrences of 'بدء النسخة التجريبية' / 'احصل على 14 يوم' / trial-status-bar). (2) POST /api/auth/login returns subscription_active/subscription_type/subscription_plan/subscription_end in user object for both Owner_homeme and royal-city admin. (3) GET /api/auth/me returns same + subscription_code_used. (4) GET /api/compounds/{id}/subscription returns full payload {compound_id, compound_name, subscription:{...,days_remaining}, plans:{residential[4], company[3]}}; compound_admin of a different compound gets 403; unauth gets 401. (5) POST /api/compounds/{id}/subscription/apply-code returns 400 on invalid/empty code; 403 when cross-compound. (6) CompoundSubscriptionCard (data-testid='compound-subscription-card') visible on admin dashboard with sub-type='🔖 دائم (Lifetime)' and ♾️ 'بدون تاريخ انتهاء'. Change-subscription-btn opens the change-sub-dialog with 3 tabs (change-sub-tab-code/card/bank), code input + apply button, and 4 plan tiles (change-sub-plan-*) in card+bank tabs. Invalid code test: backend returned 400 as expected (network log), toast triggered. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/compound_subscription.py is clean: explicit RBAC via _can_manage_compound, _format_subscription derives days_remaining safely with tz-aware math, plan catalogue is mirrored with the frontend config. Single source-of-truth comment correctly points to /app/frontend/src/config/plans.js.

subscription_codes.py apply_code propagation: correctly updates compound doc AND cascades to all admin/compound_admin users of the compound, skipping residents. Uses compound_id != 'default-compound' guard. Good exception handling (try/except with log).
routes/auth.py login + /me correctly surface subscription_* fields with sensible defaults (subscription_type defaults to 'trial', subscription_active to False).

TrialStatus.js hasPaidSubscription check is now robust: covers all non-trial types AND checks subscription_active !== false, avoiding false negatives. The early return before the /api/trial/status fetch also saves a network call.

CompoundSubscriptionCard.js is self-contained, ~340 lines - within limit. Good data-testid coverage on every interactive element. PlanPicker is a nice extraction but currently only shows residential plans in card/bank tabs - company plans in the catalogue are fetched but not rendered to the user to pick. Minor nit: allPlans variable is computed but unused.
Minor: CompoundSubscriptionCard.js calls axios directly (not via a shared apiClient) - not a bug, but inconsistent with the rest of the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested paths (trial banner hidden, card visible with lifetime label, dialog + 3 tabs + plan picker wired to API)

rca_of_the_issue: P0 bug (Royal City showing trial banner despite lifetime code) root cause: TrialStatus.js previously only treated subscription_type=='paid' as paid - all other durations (1_month, 3_months, lifetime, etc.) still rendered the banner. Fix in TrialStatus.js lines 30-40 now whitelists every non-'trial' subscription_type when subscription_active!==false. Additionally, /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me now include subscription_type so the frontend's user object has the data. apply_code in subscription_codes.py now propagates to compound + all admins to keep the state consistent across admin accounts. Verified by API (lifetime on /auth/me) + UI (trial-status-bar count = 0 on admin dashboard).
